description: Contrato visual do City Horizon para assets 2D pre-renderizados estilizados produzidos por pipeline 3D moderno.

intent.target: visual proprio do City Horizon, legivel em escala de gameplay e claramente 2D no runtime
intent.notTarget: emulacao literal de limitacoes graficas de jogos dos anos 2000
intent.references: tycoons classicos podem orientar leitura, escala, silhueta e clareza, mas nao funcionam como limite tecnico

vegetationGuidance.canopy: preserve irregular organic silhouette, readable foliage mass and controlled internal variation
vegetationGuidance.trunk: use a dedicated wood pass with 3-5 restrained organic bark tone masses; avoid obvious radial polygon facets, triangular face-reading, diagonal plates and camouflage-like geometry patterns
vegetationGuidance.shadow: support grounding without competing with the asset
vegetationGuidance.rotationConsistency: four directions must read as the same authored asset

referenceAssets.note: Reference for stylization level, gameplay legibility and organic canopy. Its approved crown is frozen; trunk and branch finishing may evolve independently until the wood pass no longer exposes geometric lighting plates.

approval.rule: An asset is approved only when it reads coherently in gameplay context and no longer depends on modern 3D rendering cues for visual quality.
approval.vegetationRule: Do not alter an already approved canopy to solve a trunk problem. Wood and foliage must be reviewed as distinct visual regions.
